title: Wool Omnibus
author: Hugh Howey
note: conf=0.95; Goodreads lists "Wool Omnibus (Silo, #1)" by Hugh Howey, published January 25, 2012 by Broad Reach Publishing. The omnibus collects the five self-published Wool novellas (Wool 1-5, originally Silo #1-5 individually), and is catalogued as Silo book 1; later entries are Shift (#2) and Dust (#3). Author metadata "Howey" = Hugh Howey.
